title: Determination 45/1/201: stairway in a pub guest-accommodation extension and ambulant disabled people (Requirement M2)
jurisdiction: England (UK): Secretary of State determination / appeal / tribunal under the Building Act 1984 and Building Regulations; comparative test only, not Alberta
code_edition: Building Regulations 2000 (as amended): Requirement M2 (access and use); K1 cited by applicant

facts.text: The work is a new three-storey extension to a three-storey Victorian public house to form guest accommodation, in a conservation area.
The Borough Council rejected the third full plans application because the stairway in the extension is not suitable for ambulant disabled people.
The applicant states the stair in the extension complies with Requirement K1 and that access will be gained through the existing building.
Determination: the proposals for the stairway do not comply with Requirement M2 (access and use).
The determination turns on whether reasonable provision is made for ambulant disabled people to use the extension.
